code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated creatinine (suggesting possible renal impairment), hyperferritinemia, and increased INR. There is also mild elevation of basophils and monocytes. Inflammatory markers (CRP, D-dimer) are at the upper limit of normal. Findings suggest hypoxemic respiratory dysfunction, possible acute or chronic inflammation, and impaired hematopoiesis, with concern for renal involvement. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
